subject: Crate unpack sequence + tall banner mounting spec
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@eventlogistics.com>
To: rachel_kim, marissa_cole
Cc: lori.chen@venueco.com, karthik_iyer
Date: 2029-03-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crate run timing + banner tolerance

Hi Rachel / Marissa —

Attached are the latest floorplan (venue_floorplan_v3.pdf) and the tall-banner template (tall-banner-template.ai). A few items we need to lock down before load-in: 

- Unload window: can you confirm preferred dock slot/time? The venue has lanes 6–9 reserved but needs confirmed arrival times.
- Crate sequence: do you want the demo crates first (A/B) or collateral crates, and where should we stage spare carrycases?
- Tall banners: these are 8ft x 24in, top-mounted to 2 vertical supports. We need the mounting hardware type (anchor vs clamp) and the max allowable point load per support.

Quick ask: please confirm the staging cage number for overnight storage and whether we can use the back-of-booth overhead beam for banner anchors (I’ll send mount specs if that is OK).

Attachment: vendor-mount-quote.pdf (preliminary quote for H-channel + clamps).

Thanks,
Sanjay
EventLogistics LLC
Operations | mobile: +1 415-555-0198

From: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@eventlogistics.com>, marissa_cole
Cc: karthik_iyer
Date: 2029-03-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crate unpack sequence + tall banner mounting spec

Sanjay — thanks for the files. Confirming details from our side: 

- Dock slot: prefer Slot 7 for initial crate unload (0900–1100 on 2029-06-04). Please hold a 30-minute buffer for customs checks.
- Crate sequence: Send demo crates A1/A2 first (they contain kiosk hardware); collateral and swag crates next. We will stage demo crates at Booth B24 east side, collateral at Booth B24 west staging area.
- Overnight storage: use Cage C3 (locked) — security will escort at 2000 nightly.
- Banner mounting: internal note — banners are 8ft x 2ft, printed on 3mm sintra. We prefer a light H-channel (aluminum) with top clamps; target point load <= 40 lbs per bracket. Can the venue provide rated anchors? If not, we will fly with clamp system.

Karthik — you own onsite staging and lead the crate team. Can you confirm manpower (2 handlers + 1 tech) and the foam dolly availability?

Next steps: Sanjay to confirm anchor availability and provide the vendor mount spec sheet. I’ve uploaded the floorplan to the project folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cexample

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Events Lead, Redwood Inference
--
Rachel Kim
Events & Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0177

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rachel_kim, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@eventlogistics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer, lori.chen@venueco.com
Date: 2029-03-13T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crate unpack sequence + tall banner mounting spec

Adding a few details from production: 

- Mounting spec: production suggests extruded aluminum H-channel with 3x clamp points (top/mid/bottom) per 8ft banner; we can keep each clamp at ~12lbs working load to stay under your 40lb point target.
- Back-of-booth beam: we cannot attach permanent anchors to the beam without venue sign-off — Lori, is a temporary clamp solution acceptable on your overhead rail?
- Crate labels: please ensure crates A1/A2 are labeled with red "DEMO" stickers and include a one-line content manifest on the outside. We will add a quick crate-run-checklist.xlsx to the folder (attached).

Forwarding Sanjay’s quote for mounts — see vendor-mount-quote.pdf. If venue-provided anchors are not possible, we’ll order clamps and a small anchor plate kit.

On staffing: Karthik, can you confirm arrival at 0830 and a 2-hour unload window? If we need extra hands we’ll pull from the booth crew pool.

Cc: karthik_iyer
Date: 2029-03-13T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crate unload + banner mount confirmation

Hi all —

We can confirm the following from the venue side: 

- Slot 7 reserved for Redwood on 2029-06-04, 0900–1100 (security informed). Please bring photo ID for gate.
- Cage C3 is available for overnight storage — access via security wristband only.
- Overhead rail: temporary clamp mounts are acceptable. Our rails support up to 75 lbs point load with approved temp clamps; we require a signed mounting waiver (I’ll attach after you confirm) and a proof of insurance naming VenueCo as additional insured.
- Mount hardware: H-channel + 3 clamps is fine. We recommend using the vendor’s anchor plates for redundancy.

I’ve attached the vendor-mount-quote.pdf with load ratings and the mounting waiver draft.

Pickup slot for leftover crates: please schedule pickup with our dock coordinator (slot #PX-44).

Let me know if you want me to circulate the mounting waiver as a DocuSign.

Cheers,
Lori Chen
Venue Operations | VenueCo
Phone: +1 415-555-0233
